WE’RE PROTEUS SPORTS GROUP

SPORT BRINGS
US TOGETHER.

Our goal is simple: make sport accessible and enjoyable for everyone. Since 2018 we’ve grown into Canterbury’s trusted coaching team, with nearly 60 coaches who care about the people as much as the game.

QUALITY COACHING. STRONGER COMMUNITIES.

OUR STORY

BUILT FOR
TRANSFORMATION.

Proteus Sports Group was founded in 2018 by Ollie Hawkins and Myles Gardner to help schools and clubs save time by supplying great coaches. Proteus was the Greek god who could change his form, and that’s what we do: shape young players, build new skills and help people become better team-mates.

Today we work alongside preschools, schools, clubs, councils, community organisations and retirement villages. From early childhood to competitive teams, we deliver structured programmes that build movement skills, develop talent and keep people in sport for life.

WHERE WE ARE TODAY

A GROWING TEAM.
A BIGGER IMPACT.

In the first term of 2026 alone, nearly 60 coaches delivered programmes across Christchurch, supporting hundreds of athletes every week.
